t: #3688 Bitwise OR of Even Numbers in an Array
o: OR together every even element of nums; return 0 if none exist. Tiny constraints (n, values <= 100) make a single pass trivially sufficient.
k: Bitwise OR is associative and order-independent — one accumulation pass.
Parity test x % 2 == 0 (or x & 1 == 0) selects evens.

a.i: Fold OR over the even elements starting from identity 0.
s: For each x, if x is even, result |= x.

w: Nothing to trip on; the identity element 0 naturally handles the empty case. Follow-up: OR of odds, or AND/XOR variants — identical skeleton with a different fold.
